activeExperiment.name: R4-Y / R4-Z Labor Coherence — ultra-shard + runtime recovery
activeExperiment.description: The 120-regime ultra-shard has produced many complete control/production artifacts and a first full 24m hybrid result. Slow settlement/realized/hybrid trajectories are being recovered separately after exact runtime equivalence validation and a same-horizon 12m probe launch.

runtimeRecovery.interpretation: The exact labor/payroll acceleration is state-equivalent, but the measured speedup is too small to explain the pathological slow-variant runtime by itself.

causalChain: Physical production plans require far more labor than firms can sustainably pay from settled/realized operating flows
Canonical requested labor sits between the two constraints: often too low for physical plans yet too high for sustainable payroll
Production-linked staffing restores employment/output but finances the expansion through large current-worker wage arrears
A hard realized-payroll hybrid removes arrears by collapsing employment and real output instead of restoring viability
Payroll distress drives repeated restructuring and later firm-exit propagation
Inactive estates then strand physical and financial resources, amplifying the collapse
Current repair frontier: a bounded production–payroll transition rather than either unconstrained physical hiring or a hard prior-cash cap

researchTimeline.result: Long-run collapse reproduced under controlled baseline.
Labor matching, voluntary consumption cuts, and single-factor credit explanations narrowed or rejected as primary roots.
Exit propagation identified as a major late-stage unemployment amplifier; generic root search closed.
Entrant credit timing and startup-finance defects confirmed, but aggregate employment impact remained secondary.
Estate stranding and accounting representation defects confirmed; tax-feedback root hypothesis falsified.
Restructure-vs-liquidate architecture shown to be economically material; supply relief becomes a complement after restructuring.
Detached former-worker claims exist, but do not explain the restructuring arrears penalty; current-worker arrears dominate.
Post-restructure payroll coverage remains severely inadequate and restructuring recurs across original and held-out seeds.
Original A/B and held-out E/F reproduce the same production-payroll wedge: production-linked staffing sharply improves employment/output while multiplying current-worker arrears.
First full 24m hard-hybrid completion eliminates arrears but drives mean unemployment to 87.3% and collapses output, falsifying the hard affordability cap as a sufficient repair.

Exact diagnostic labor/payroll acceleration passed bit-exact equivalence. Its modest speedup shows the pathological slow variants are not explained by queue/payroll implementation cost alone; full-horizon recovery and a 12m same-horizon probe were launched.

notes: Diagnostic-only results are kept separate from canonical production repairs.
Observer instrumentation must not alter simulation state.
A PASS on accounting identity is not treated as proof of economic realism.
Production-linked staffing is rejected as a standalone repair because it produces large unpaid payroll liabilities.
Hard hybrid staffing is rejected on the first full 24m completion because it cures arrears through mass unemployment/output destruction.
Actions artifacts are supporting evidence, not the sole permanent record; closure-level evidence is committed to the repository.
